Setup · two codes in order

Begin at the fresh Android welcome screen. Use Code 1 to enroll and install TinyMDM and the app while online. Once the app is installed, use its Scan Your Factory Code screen for Code 2.

Code 1 · Android enrollment

Open the installation page on a computer or second screen. On the fresh tablet’s Android welcome screen, tap the same spot six times to open its provisioning QR scanner. Connect Wi-Fi when prompted, scan Code 1, and stay online while TinyMDM installs Factory Commissioning.

Open installation page ↗

Code 2 · app configuration

In Factory Commissioning, open Scan Your Factory Code, choose Use camera, and scan this code from a computer or second screen. Review the factory settings, tap Save, and wait for the app to restart.
